description: Cross-platform author experience authority for QHD through high-end desktop viewports; FHD and lower physical displays are outside the formal support matrix.

boundaries.visualRegression: Linux strict screenshot baseline remains a separate pixel authority and is not part of the platform experience viewport matrix.
boundaries.windowsIme: Real Microsoft Pinyin composition remains a dedicated Windows native IME gate.
boundaries.packageSmoke: Packaged startup remains independent and cannot substitute for the author experience flow.
boundaries.lowResolution: FHD and lower physical displays are not formal support or release-blocking tiers; narrow CSS/DIP viewports remain fallback-only.
